text:
Maria: Quick sync — we need final changelog + docs links for the announce tomorrow 09:00 PT. Who can confirm the canonical changelog URL? Also canary schedule (30% -> 100%) and webinar registration link for the post? :eyes:

Ajit: Put the changelog at https://redwood.com/docs/changelog/v2-1-0.md — final draft, but we decided to include the migration notes. Canary starts 09:30 PT, 30% for 1h, then 60% for 1h, then 100% at 11:30. @Kevin can you confirm the docs path is live? :thumbsup:

Kevin: Docs pushed to staging, routing to prod now. Final prod URL will be https://docs.redwood.com/inference/v2.1/release-notes. I just updated the 'benchmark narrative' section — added a short blurb about throughput improvements vs. v1. See snippet:

```
Throughput improved ~2.2x at p50 latency for 2k-seq workloads. See perf/benchmarks/2026-03-v2-run.md
```

Ajit: Note: we switched the default model variant in hosted from rdm-v2 to rdm-v2-optimized-8q — fallback rules are set. This affects the bench wording (we're comparing apples->apples with quantized variant). Added note to changelog.

Samuel: Webinar RSVP landing page: https://events.redwood.com/v2-launch — please confirm hero copy. Marketing wants: 'See v2 in action: cost & latency wins for production inference'. Maria can you review CTA?

Maria: CTA ok but tweak to 'cost‑effective production inference' and add 'Q&A with Eng' line. Also need lead routing: make sure signups tag 'launch_v2' and flow to SFDC campaign 'Launch_V2_March'. @Jason-sales can you confirm?

Jason-sales: confirmed. We'll create the campaign + add attribution. Leads with 'launch_v2' will hit the SDR queue with priority tag.

Kevin: One more thing — docs anchor names changed (we renamed 'perf-results' -> 'bench-results'). If marketing is embedding anchors, please use #bench-results. I'll keep redirects for 48h.

Maria: Thx. Last ask: canary rollback plan? If error rate > 2% we'll auto-roll back and notify channel eng-oncall and marketing. @deploy-bot can you confirm webhooks set?

deploy-bot: webhook to #eng-oncall and #marketing configured. Canary healthchecks enabled: 5m windows, alerts on error rate >2% or p95 latency regression >20%.

Ajit: We'll ship the changelog link in the announce payload. Maria — want me to paste final links for the release note + docs + webinar in the announce doc now?

Maria: Yes please paste them into the announce doc and ping me once done. I'll queue the social posts and the email blast.

Kevin: Pasted. Final links:
- Changelog: https://redwood.com/docs/changelog/v2-1-0.md
- Release notes: https://docs.redwood.com/inference/v2.1/release-notes
- Webinar: https://events.redwood.com/v2-launch
- Bench run: https://perf.redwood.com/bench/2026-03-v2

Maria: Got it. Posting at 09:00 PT tomorrow. I'll run the preflight checklist at 08:30. :rocket:

Ajit: Good to go from engineering side. :+1:

Samuel: I'll host the webinar. Agenda: 20m demo, 15m benchmarks walkthrough, 25m Q&A. Sharing slides to marketing channel in 2h.

Maria: perfect. Thanks everyone — last-mile sorted. :party_parrot:
